description_en: Grants permission to upload a temporary file for high-code deployment. This operation is not supported in other scenarios. After obtaining the permission, you must complete the file upload
description_zh: 该接口用于高代码部署，其他场景暂不支持。用于申请临时文件上传许可，之后需要自己完成文件上传动作
